rationale: The independent warning identifies exactly the same false closure under negation as the targeted judge rejection, whose confirmed-fatal repair restricts preservation to positive Boolean combinations.

The definition omitted the O(n) all-tapes space needed to decode and retain a length-n encoded pair; this is distinct from the judge's time-bound objection and is repaired by the explicit O(n+S+log(b+2)) bound.
A power basis of an arbitrary order means O=Z[alpha], not O_K=Z[alpha]. The repair distinguishes the order case from the monogenic full-ring case.
The warning and exact judge rejection identify the same missing residual-cover and finite-gap telescoping construction, resolved by the single licensed repair.

The uniqueness argument omitted one standard sentence: the difference of two lifts factors through a homomorphism from the perfect universal-extension source to the abelian central kernel, hence is trivial. A competent reader closes this immediately, so no content change is licensed.

The suppressed identity 0=product(1-a_x)=1+(terms in A), together with the separately immediate zero-ideal branch, is a one-line expansion. The result and proof strategy are correct, so no content change is warranted.

The coefficient domain was not required to contain the initial graph, so a(gamma(y),phi(y)), b(gamma(y),phi(y)), and the characteristic initial values could be undefined. The repair types the coefficient domain and requires the initial graph to lie in it; this is independent of the judge rejection's local trace-scope defect.
The independent warning identifies the same zero-target counterexample as the confirmed-fatal judge rejection; the repair adds the nonzero-unit hypothesis.
The confirmed-fatal repair corrects the dual transposition and proves the needed dimension equality over arbitrary fields, resolving the reader warning without importing the source field restriction.
The judge and reader independently identify the same undefined decisive hypothesis; the judge-confirmed fatal repair states the closed deformation-neighborhood condition.
The decisive term well-pointed was undefined; the repaired statement defines it as a basepoint inclusion that is a cofibration.
A compact-set continuation argument gives a common local flow interval and finite iteration gives invariance for each fixed positive and negative time; no content change is warranted.
The reader and judge identify the same empty-set boundary failure; the exact confirmed-fatal rejection licenses the repaired C(empty)=empty qualification.
The reader and judge identify the same ordered-wedge sign error; the exact confirmed-fatal rejection licenses the corrected differential.

The independent reader and judge identify the same absent mathematical definition: the item had no source, target, or formula. The exact confirmed-fatal rejection licenses the repaired evaluation map.
The independent reader and judge identify the same dropped Choice hypothesis from the cited subgroup-of-free theorem. The exact confirmed-fatal rejection licenses adding Choice.
The independent reader and judge identify the same omitted Choice assumption behind the cited basis theorem. The exact confirmed-fatal rejection licenses the repaired hypothesis.

This warning and the exact target rejection identify the same missing compatible Polish presentations and sequential-compactness support in the diagonal argument. The confirmed-fatal rejection licenses the single repair already made to that item.

This warning and the exact target rejection identify the same unsupported sqrt(8) use of the large-Y lemma. The confirmed-fatal rejection licenses the one repair narrowing the numerical conclusion to the lemma's stated threshold 2.

The selected centre and a covered point can be at distance exactly twice the closed-ball radius, but for any requested open-net radius one chooses the original scale with twice its radius strictly smaller. This is an immediate finite-net clarification and does not warrant a content change.
